title: Civil Engineering graduate / junior - expression of interest (Victoria)
content_text: Spiire careers page invites expressions of interest with CV and motivation letter when no matching advertised role is listed. Civil Engineering team covers due diligence, engineering design, water engineering and construction consultancy. Graduate stories and development pathways are featured on the careers site.
apply_instructions: Email expression of interest with CV and motivation letter to spiire.careers@spiire.com.au (mailto on careers page Register your interest).
